thread:
morgan: quick heads-up: noticed Keys API returning owner_org/project for keys that are used across tenants. risky to surface in Console.
alina: can you paste the raw payload?
morgan: sure:
```json
{"key_id":"k-92f","owner_org":"org-42","project":"payments-q1","created_by":"svc-batcher"}
```
jia: is that enrichment coming from auth-service or the frontend proxy?
leo: auth-service returns owner_* for attribution. proxy currently forwards the payload verbatim to Console.
alina: Console showing that to org admins and some SRE roles?
morgan: yes, visible in key detail page and in support panel. we should avoid leaking owner mapping across tenants.
nate: principle: hide identity mapping unless viewer has explicit audit entitlement. simplest fix is presentation-redaction in proxy/Console.
jia: agree but we need auditability for ops. Propose: redact in Console responses, but emit internal audit events with owner resolution details.
leo: quick implementation options:
- redaction at proxy (easy): remove owner_org/project fields before returning to Console, add header X-Owner-Redacted: true
- redaction at Console (harder): Console calls admin-only endpoint to fetch owner metadata when entitlement present
leads: proxy redaction + audit events seems fastest.
alina: check downstream impact: our billing and quota attribution pipelines use owner_project to route usage. cannot break that.
morgan: confirmed: billing uses the auth-service internal events to attribute usage, not Console responses. so redaction can be presentation-only.
jia: please also ensure third-party integrators calling Keys API get clear signal. add X-Owner-Redacted header so integrations notice redaction.
leo: I'll add a response meta flag redacted_owner=true and header X-Owner-Redacted: true. auth-service will still emit owner info into internal kafka audit topic.
nate: UX: when Console sees redacted_owner it should display: "Owner: Restricted — contact security" with link to request audit. show a tooltip explaining why.
alina: legal review needed for wording. i'll draft and ping legal.
morgan: propose rollout plan:
1) proxy: implement redaction and header (canary 10% of Console orgs) — 72h cadence for infra PR
2) auth-service: add audit events for owner resolution, include request_id and original payload (internal-only)
3) Console: detect redaction flag and show blurred/locked state behind feature flag with entitlement check for admin flows
4) telemetry: add metric auth.owner_resolved_count and proxy.owner_redacted_count to validate behavior

jia: also add an internal-only endpoint /v1/keys/{id}/owner that requires special scope to fetch owner metadata for SRE/audit.
leo: ETA thoughts: proxy change 2d, auth audit event 3d, Console UI + flag 4d. canary the flag to 10% then 100% after smoke.
morgan: can everyone ack? we should avoid back-and-forth on implementation details in PRs.
alina: ack. i'll own legal copy.
nate: ack on RBAC + long-term entitlement plan. also update docs for Integrations.
jia: ack, i'll create the internal endpoint and schema for the audit event.
leo: ack, will open proxy PR and add header.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry alert: auth service owner_resolution=true observed in 3.8% of key lookups in last 24h.
morgan: thanks. i'll file the RFC short doc and tag infra oncall. will post PR links here.
alina: thanks all :thumbsup:
